title: The deployment's list
description: deploy/production.json, format 1: the exact releases of api and of app's build that the deployment ships, by tag and sha256 of each file, and the lowest admission rung of api's models (R05). A pull request changes it by hand, and its merge into main is the deployment. A field this schema does not know is an error.

format.description: The version of this list's format.

release.description: The tag of the release of altnovatrail/api whose binary and Dockerfile the image is built from.

name.description: The binary's file in the release, api_<tag>_linux_amd64, as api's release names it (R28 api); the check holds its tag to release.

sha256.description: The sha256 of the release's file Dockerfile.

api.description: The release of api. The packages of the modules are not named here: the build of api's image puts them in by the modules.json its binary holds (R07 api).

release.description: The tag of the release of altnovatrail/app whose build is shipped.

name.description: The build's archive in the release, as app's release names it.

sha256.description: The sha256 of deploy/production/deployment.json, the /deployment.json shipped beside the build (Т-19).

app.description: The release of app's build, and the file of its deployment's values.

rung.description: The lowest admission rung of api's models, by tutor's code. The schema knows both; the deployment ships only full, which a check of its own holds (R25 api).

tag.description: An exact tag of a release, vMAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

sha256.description: A sha256, as 64 lowercase hexadecimal digits.
